name.value: The Village Taphouse Fine Wines Spirits & Ales

description.value: The Village Taphouse is a full-service restaurant and taphouse operated by Cactus Restaurants Ltd. at the Park Royal complex, offering an extensive menu of shareable plates, pizzas, burgers, salads, and handhelds alongside a drinks program spanning wines, spirits, and ales. A touring cyclist can fuel up with a proper sit-down meal or grab takeout and delivery, making it a practical stop on a North Shore ride. The restaurant is affiliated with Ocean Wise seafood sourcing and offers several plant-forward dishes alongside the heartier fare.

address.value: 900 Main St, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0A5, Canada
